question: When the Ring tempts me and I control a creature, can I choose not to pick a Ring-bearer?

expected.shortAnswer: No: each time the Ring tempts you, you must choose a creature if you control one.
expected.answer: Each time the Ring tempts you, you must choose a creature if you control one.
